_comment: FICTIONAL adjustment history records for the statistics goldens. A record carries only the fields the statistics read: brandId (symbolic; null = unmatched brand), carrierCode, serviceId (null = unresolved), shipDate, adjustmentType, cause, packageRef (null = none), originalCharge / correctedCharge / separateFee (customer-facing amounts, strings; null = unknown, never 0), postageDifference (= correctedCharge - originalCharge when both are present, else null; the database generates it).
